payload.claim: orphan_rows checks store.is_file() on queue.json and returns early without taking the lock, but unlike append_queue_line it never calls _migrate_v0_store first. If a repo's batch tree still holds the pre-rename lines.json (not yet migrated because no append_queue_line call has run yet this session), orphan_rows sees no queue.json and silently treats the directory as having nothing to rewrite, even though live rows exist under the old filename. The docstring's claim that 'a repo's first night has nothing for this to rewrite' is true for a genuinely fresh out_dir but false for one still on the old store name, and no test exercises this cross-version on-disk format case since every test seeds queue.json directly.
